streaming_contract.proxy: awaits the complete Worker JSON response before constructing a plain-text Response
streaming_contract.first_byte_meaning: the proxy has a complete parsed answer; it is not evidence of first model-token timing
streaming_contract.transport_chunks: runtime transport may deliver one or more chunks; source does not promise token cadence or chunk count
streaming_contract.browser: reads response.body with ReadableStream.getReader(), decodes each delivered chunk, and updates accumulated text after each read
streaming_contract.headers: sources, model compatibility, and fallback metadata are read before the body loop
